prompt: Design a SaaS analytics dashboard with four tiles: (1) Monthly recurring revenue trend, (2) Conversion rate by traffic source, (3) Cohort retention heatmap, (4) Top 10 customers by MRR.
expected_output: Per references/data-viz.md § The 25-chart selection matrix: (1) Line chart for MRR trend (one series over time). (2) Horizontal bar chart for conversion by source (compare across categories with long source names). (3) Heatmap for cohort retention (two-dimensional matrix). (4) Horizontal bar OR ranked table for top customers (compare ordered values). Uses colour-blind-safe palette: Okabe-Ito for categorical chart series ($chart1 through $chart8 in tokens), Viridis (perceptually uniform) for the heatmap. NEVER uses pie chart with > 5 slices. NEVER 3D charts. NEVER dual y-axes (split into small multiples instead). Sparklines used inline in the KPI cards above the main charts. State coding pairs colour with shape (up arrow ↑ + $success for growth; down arrow ↓ + $danger for decline) so colour-blind users can read it. Default chart styling: minimal axes, light gridlines on the value axis only, direct labels at line endpoints, tabular numerics on monetary values.
